Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick onboarding touchpoint earlier. Attached are the items your procurement team requested so we can get WavePay set up in Redwood: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, wavepay_wire_instructions.pdf, and a copy of our W-9 (W-9_WavePay.pdf).

Bank / ACH details (for Redwood setup):
- Bank name: First National Bank (FNB)
- Routing (ACH): 111000025
- Account number: 423871209
- Account name: WavePay Systems, Inc.
- Remittance email: ap@wavepay.com

We can accept either ACH or wire for initial payments. If you require micro-deposit verification, our AP team can initiate two small test deposits today — they typically show up within 1–2 business days. If you need a bank letter or a voided check instead, let us know and we'll attach it.

Also included in the packet is our preferred remittance format: please include the Redwood PO number and invoice number in the remittance comments so our reconciliations pick up automatically.

Let me know if you need anything else to complete the vendor record.

Thanks,
Dana Ruiz

Thanks, Dana — got the packet and the ACH info. A few quick items from procurement & finance: 

- Redwood policy requires vendor bank verification before sending net-30 payments. We typically do micro-deposits unless a bank letter is provided. Can you confirm whether your AP team prefers micro-deposits or will provide a bank verification letter/voided check?
- Please confirm the two micro-deposit amounts (if you do micro-deposits) so Finance can verify and then flip the vendor to "Active".
- Our accounting team needs the remittance email and the preferred EU/US tax residency info for 1099/withholding. The W-9 you sent helps; if there is a supplemental certificate please attach.

I've attached our procurement_checklist.pdf (internal) for reference. Also share any DocuSign link for the vendor agreement so our legal team can sign. Once bank verification is confirmed we'll issue PO RW-2026-4538 and share the PO PDF. Please confirm the following remittance fields you require: PO number, invoice number, and a project code (if applicable).

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

- Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

We can do micro-deposits — AP ran them this morning. Expected amounts are $0.12 and $0.45. You should see them hit the account within 24–48 hours (FNB processing). Once you confirm the amounts we can mark your vendor account as verified and accept ACH payments.

Additional attachments I’m including now: W-9_WavePay_signed.pdf and bank_letter_wavepay.pdf (signed bank confirmation).

DocuSign for the vendor agreement: https://app.docusign.com/signer/abcd-efgh-1234 (signed by our CFO, awaiting Redwood sign-off).

A couple of clarifications to help with remittance processing:
- Preferred remittance email: ap@wavepay.com
- Required remittance fields: PO number (preferred), Invoice number, and optionally a Project code.
- If you plan to send wire instead of ACH, our wire routing is listed in wavepay_wire_instructions.pdf — wires typically clear same day depending on bank cutoffs.

Let me know when the micro-deposit amounts are confirmed and please share the PO.

Thanks,

Notes / attachments:
- Attached: po_RW-2026-4538.pdf (official PO)
- We received W-9_WavePay_signed.pdf and bank_letter_wavepay.pdf — thank you.
- DocuSign link works; legal will complete signature today.

Appreciate the quick assistance getting this across the finish line. Welcome aboard.

Best,
